title: Reduction of effective fppf descent for a morphism property to affine singleton covers
statement: Let $\mathcal P$ be a property of morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], invariant under isomorphism. Suppose (i) it is preserved by arbitrary base change [def-pc-fibre-product]; (ii) whenever $h_j:Y_j\to B_j$ have $\mathcal P$ for $1\le j\le m$, the morphism $\coprod_jY_j\to\coprod_jB_j$ of coproducts [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family] has $\mathcal P$, including $m=0$; and (iii) for every flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] morphism $p:A\to B$ of finite presentation between affine schemes, every scheme descent datum on $V\to A$ [def-pd-descent-datum] with $\mathcal P(V\to A)$ is effective. Here finite presentation means locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then for every fppf covering $\{T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] and every scheme descent datum $(V_i,\phi_{ij})$ with $\mathcal P(V_i\to T_i)$, that datum is effective. In the family notation, $\phi_{ij}:V_i\times_T T_j\simeq T_i\times_T V_j$ are isomorphisms over $T_i\times_T T_j$ satisfying the cocycle on triple overlaps; effectiveness means a $T$-scheme $V_0$ with compatible isomorphisms $V_0\times_T T_i\simeq V_i$. All schemes and families are taken in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, specialization to tau=fppf; invoked by Tag 02W8 in its first proof paragraph.

proof.text: For every point t of T choose a covering member T_{j(t)} and a point above t. The family indexed by T (lifted to the site indexing universe) is still fppf and its two scheme coproducts exist because T is u-small. Restrict the local schemes, representing bijections and all transitions to this family; its cocycle and property P are inherited. We first prove effectivity for this restricted datum by steps 2-5. This choice is valid also for empty T, when the restricted family is empty.

source.place: Tag 02W3, preliminary pullback observation; Tag 02W0, refinement of coverings. The point-indexed subcover resolves the fixed-universe coproduct requirement.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-fppf-family-coproduct-descent-encoding] to the restricted small family datum. It gives $A=\coprod_iT_i$, $Z=\coprod_iV_i$, the singleton datum $D$ on $Z/A/T$, and the fpqc covering $f:A\to T$. It also identifies realizations of $D$ with compatible realizations of the restricted small family, without assuming that $Z\to A$ has $\mathcal P$.

source.place: Tag 023X, lemma-family-is-one; Tag 02W3, change from family to singleton

proof.text: Fix an affine open $U\subset T$. Apply [lem-trf-fppf-affine-refinement-pullback-model]. It supplies the restricted datum $D_U$, its compatible projection to $D$, an affine flat surjective finite-presentation fpqc cover $p:C\to U$, a refinement $h:C\to A_U$, and a transport-compatible Cartesian pullback datum $E$. Its underlying map is isomorphic to $\coprod_jQ_j\to\coprod_jW_j$, with $Q_j=V_{i(j)}\times_{T_{i(j)}}W_j$. By (i) each $Q_j\to W_j$ has $\mathcal P$; by (ii) their finite coproduct has $\mathcal P$, also for $m=0$. Isomorphism invariance gives $\mathcal P$ for the underlying map of $E$. Hypothesis (iii), with precisely the properties of $p$ supplied by the lemma, therefore makes $E$ effective over $U$.

source.place: Tag 02W3, preliminary pullback observation and affine-base paragraph, assumptions (1)-(3)

proof.text: The singleton $A_U\to U$ is fpqc by [lem-galois-fpqc-covering-base-change], applied to $f$ and $U\to T$. Both $A_U\to U$ and $p:C\to U$ are consequently singleton fpqc covers. The Cartesian projection of $E$ to $D_U$ over $h$ intertwines transports by step 3. Thus [lem-galois-fpqc-refinement-reflects-effectivity] applies and makes $D_U$ effective.

source.place: Tag 02W3, affine-base paragraph using Tag 02W0, lemma-refine-coverings-fully-faithful

proof.text: For every affine open $U$, step 3 gives a restricted datum on $Z_U=Z\times_AA_U$ whose projection intertwines transports with $D$, and step 4 proves its effectivity. Apply [lem-galois-fpqc-effectivity-open-local] to the fpqc singleton $f$ and $D$. It yields an effective realization $V_0/T$ of $D$. The realization equivalence of [lem-trf-fppf-family-coproduct-descent-encoding] yields compatible isomorphisms $V_0\times_TT_i\simeq V_i$, for the restricted small family. This uses no claim that $V_0\to T$ has $\mathcal P$.

source.place: Tag 02W3, general-base relative gluing paragraph; Tag 023X, recovery of the family

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-fppf-sheaf-representability-descent-data] to the original family and to the small subcover. This gives global sheaves H and H_small, each with a natural isomorphism from its full local descent datum to the specified one. The isomorphism for H restricts, by choosing its components j(t), to an isomorphism on the small covering. The transition-commutation equations are exactly the original equations at j(t), j(t′). Compose with the inverse of the small-data comparison. Full faithfulness in [lem-pe-set-sheaf-cover-descent] gives H_small isomorphic to H. Effectivity proved in step 5 makes H_small representable. Representability transfers along that isomorphism, and the effectivity clause of [lem-trf-fppf-sheaf-representability-descent-data] now gives the original family effectivity. No property is required of the global realization.

source.place: Tag 02W0, full faithfulness under refinement; Tag 02W5, family scheme data versus locally representable sheaves. Used only to transfer a realization from the small subcover, not to construct it.

proof_origin.place: Tags 02W3 and 023X: affine-refinement assembly followed by open-local effectivity. A point-indexed subcover makes the coproducts available in Scheme.{u}; Tags 02W0 and 02W5 (full faithfulness and the sheaf comparison) transfer its effective realization to the original family.

reviewed_lean.note: The statement matches node and Stacks 02W3 (tau=fppf) clause by clause. P is a MorphismProperty; RespectsIso is implied by IsStableUnderBaseChange, so not stronger; (i) is IsStableUnderBaseChange over all cartesian squares; (ii) hfinite covers every Fin n family with Sigma.map, n=0 included; (iii) haffine: IsAffine A, B and Flat/Surjective/LocallyOfFinitePresentation/QuasiCompact/QuasiSeparated, exactly the node's finite-presentation convention, with every V : Over A and Over.DescentDatum p V. Cover: ofArrows in fppfPrecoverage (flat+lfp, jointly surjective), no finiteness or affineness restriction. Datum and effectivity use the landed SchemeCoverDescentDatum and its IsEffective (no duplicate definition); P of the descended scheme is not claimed. I : Type (u+1) is fixed by the landed definition and Type u families embed via ULift, so no restriction. The node changes only in lean and in stmt_deps gaining the landed def-trf-scheme-cover-descent-datum (allowed by brief §5). lean.statement is verbatim in the file. Edge cases I empty, m=0, empty affines, infinite I: fine.
